show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/PY2NNk
show.description: A single-narrater show, where we understand the essence of Bhagwad Gita Shloks though stories that deal with every day problems. In each episode, we talk about an everyday problem or situation, through the lens of 'Pandit Ji' who runs 'Gita Gyaan' blog. Though the story, we hear a situational problem or hurdle - either through people around Pandit Ji or the blog readers. Pandit ji as a solution narrates a Gita Shlok and explains the meaning as well as its application for the situation.
